runtime_requirements.reason: The mod ships as an opengl32.dll proxy planted next to stormworks64.exe. The real Windows opengl32.dll must be captured alongside it as opengl32_real.dll so the proxy can forward all 365 non-intercepted GL exports to it; without it the game gets no OpenGL and cannot render. The file is not redistributable, so it is captured from the user's own System32 at install time.
